subject: POC signal & monitoring runway — next steps and owners
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Chen <alex.chen@alderanalytics.com>
Cc: Sophie Lambert <sophie.lambert@alderanalytics.com>
Date: 2028-05-11T14:12:00-07:00
Subject: POC signal & monitoring runway — next steps and owners

Alex / Sophie — thanks again for a productive discovery call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we have alignment before the trial kicks off.

Key goals (what Alder needs to validate during the trial):
- Latency under 150ms p50 for 1–2k concurrent inference requests
- No functional regressions on your taxonomy prompts (sample prompt set attached)
- End-to-end tracing from app -> Redwood runtime to the model to support root-cause on failures

POC plan (3 weeks):
1) Week 0 (pre-start) — data & access: share test tenant details, sample logs, and the 6 canonical prompts.
2) Week 1 — baseline run: run traffic generator against your staging endpoints; collect metrics & traces.
3) Week 2 — optimization & validation: enable KV caching and recommended batching; iterate on any prompt failures.
4) Week 3 — acceptance: run acceptance harness and produce dashboard + pass/fail checklist.

Success criteria (minimum pass):
- p95 latency < 400ms, p50 < 150ms under expected concurrency
- Error rate < 0.5% for inference requests
- End-to-end traces captured for > 95% of sampled requests and searchable in your tracing UI
- Two dashboards: a performance overview and an error breakdown by code/prompt

Owners / roles (proposed):
- Alder: Alex (Technical Lead) — provide staging endpoints, test data, and SLA on execution windows
- Alder: Sophie (QA) — run the prompt acceptance harness and report regressions
- Redwood: Neha (AE) — program management / weekly syncs
- Redwood: Ben Carter (Solutions Eng) — instrumentation & dashboard setup, runbook draft
- Redwood: Laura Bennett (Customer Success) — onboarding and go/no-go coordination

Immediate asks from Alder (items we need before starting):
- Share a short set of 6 canonical prompts and expected outputs (attachment: POC-Acceptance-Criteria-v1.xlsx)
- Provide a test/stage endpoint and a contact for your infra (IP allowlist window)
- Confirm whether you want logs exported to Splunk or prefer push to S3 (we support both)

I've attached the acceptance criteria spreadsheet and a sample metrics payload to speed Ben's onboarding. Proposed cadence: twice-weekly 30m touchpoints (Mon/Thu) during the run; one exit review on Week 3 Friday.

If that looks good I'll schedule the kickoff and loop Ben in to propose dashboard definitions and the tracing instrument plan.

Thanks,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference

Attachments: POC-Acceptance-Criteria-v1.xlsx (spreadsheet), sample-metrics.jsonl (text)

From: Alex Chen <alex.chen@alderanalytics.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sophie Lambert <sophie.lambert@alderanalytics.com>
Date: 2028-05-11T17:28:00-07:00
Subject: Re: POC signal & monitoring runway — next steps and owners

Neha — thanks for the clear recap, that matches our internal notes. A few clarifications and constraints on our side:

- We prefer logs exported to our Splunk instance (splunk://alerts.alder.internal) for compliance reasons. Can Redwood push structured inference logs (JSON) directly to an HTTP collector?
- Our infra team needs a minimum 24 hour maintenance window for IP allowlisting. We can open a window next Tue 5/16 01:00–05:00 UTC if that works.
- On success criteria: can you confirm whether Redwood will capture sampling traces for cold-start vs warm requests separately? We need both to diagnose caching behavior.

Also, Sophie will be the primary QA during the trial — she will run the acceptance harness and report failures via the shared spreadsheet.

If you can get Ben to outline the dashboards he’ll create and the Prometheus-style metrics we should expect, we can validate against our internal monitoring team.

Appreciate it — Alex
Technical Lead, Alder Analytics

Subject: RE: POC signal & monitoring runway — next steps and owners

Thanks — looping in proposed telemetry & dashboard plan below. I also attached a small sample metrics payload (sample-metrics.jsonl) so Alder can drop it into their ingestion pipeline for quick validation.

Telemetry outputs Redwood will provide during the POC:
- Metrics (Prometheus format, pushed via remote_write or exported as JSONL):
  - redwood.inference.requests_total{model,route,region} (counter)
  - redwood.inference.request_duration_seconds{quantile,model} (histogram summary)
  - redwood.inference.kv_cache_hit_ratio{model} (gauge)
  - redwood.inference.error_count{code} (counter)
- Traces: OpenTelemetry spans for request lifecycle with attributes: trace_id, request_id, model_version, prompt_hash, cache_status. Sampling: default 10% but we can increase to 100% for the baseline window.
- Structured logs: JSON lines containing request_id, latency_ms, status_code, prompt_id, and model_variant. We can ship these to an HTTP collector endpoint or to S3. Splunk HTTP Event Collector (HEC) is supported.

Dashboard proposal (to be ready Day 2):
- Performance overview (p50/p95/p99, throughput, concurrency, caching stats)
- Error taxonomy (by code, by prompt, by model_variant)
- Tracing waterfall sample: ability to click from an error in the dashboard to the trace detail (sampled spans)
- Acceptance harness results view: per-prompt pass/fail and diffs

Runbook & acceptance checklist:
- Simple runbook steps for common issues (high latency, model OOM, tokenization mismatch)
- Escalation contact: Ben Carter (redwood infra SE), secondary: Laura Bennett (CS)

Questions for Alder:
1) Splunk HEC endpoint + token for small ingestion test (we'll only send sample payloads until you sign off).
2) Confirm whether you want 100% trace sampling for the baseline week (this will increase storage but gives complete visibility).
3) Can Sophie share the acceptance harness results format (CSV/JSON) so we can integrate the results into the dashboard?

Planned immediate deliverables (Ben):
- Day 0: guide for IP allowlist and sample payloads (today).
- Day 1: baseline dashboard templates and a shared Grafana board (read-only to Alder).
- Day 3: runbook + a small demo of trace drill-downs with a sample failure.

I'll get the Grafana board link to you once it's provisioned.

Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: sample-metrics.jsonl
